decisions.topic: Production Cost Cap and Selling Price
decisions.decision_value: Set unit production cost limit at 12.50 Euros and retail selling price at 25 Euros with a 50 million Euro profit target.

disagreements.topic: Numeric Keypad vs Joystick-Only Menu Navigation
disagreements.positions: Industrial Designer Tarik Rahman argued a numeric keypad is still needed so users don't have to scroll through dozens of channels, while UI Designer Dave Cochrane and PM Adam Duguid insisted channel names/categories on the LCD menu eliminate the need for number buttons.
disagreements.semantic_target_quote: You wouldn't want to just have to scroll through all the channels to get to the one you want.

disagreements.topic: Case Material and Budget Cap Trade-off (Spongy Rubber vs Hard Plastic)
disagreements.positions: After PM Adam Duguid switched the case from articulated spongy rubber to solid hard plastic to meet the 12.50 Euro cap, UI Designer Dave Cochrane and Marketing Expert Ebenezer Ademesoye argued the budget was too restrictive and retaining the biomorphic articulated rubber would generate more sales profit than the added manufacturing expense.
